description_en: Queries user risk types and statistics related to API security in Web Application Firewall (WAF)
description_zh: 查询API安全用户风险类型和统计
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-user-abnormal-type --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-g4000201 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUserAbnormalType

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.

This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html operation to query the IDs of hybrid cloud clusters
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time is in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time is in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of risk states for which to collect statistics.

By default, statistics are collected for risks in the toBeConfirmed, toBeFixed, toBeVerified, and notFixed states
parameters.help_zh:
风险统计的状态列表。

默认统计 toBeConfirmed、toBeFixed、toBeVerified、notFixed状态的风险数据
parameters.name: user_status_list

Abnormal.description_en: The risk types detected by API security and the number of risks for each type

items.description_en: An object that contains the details of a risk type, including the risk code, category, and count

AbnormalCode.description_en: The code that identifies the specific risk, such as `Risk_InternalWeakPasswd`

AbnormalCount.description_en: The total number of risks detected for this risk type

AbnormalParentType.description_en: The parent category of the risk, such as `RiskType_Account`

AbnormalType.description_en:
The type of the risk detected by API security.

Call the [DescribeApisecRules]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2859155.html） operation to query the supported risk types
AbnormalType.description_zh:
风险类型。

您可以调用[DescribeApisecRules]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2859155.html）获取支持的风险类型
